acceptanceCriteria: staged adopter acceptance completes start, preflight, checkpoint, verify, finish, archive, cleanup, finalize, finalize-verify, and close with deleted resource disposition
staged N-1 upgrade acceptance applies the same cleanup-before-close rule for old and new Work Items
success and failure paths retain acceptance receipts while removing the exact temporary run root without deleting unrelated paths
regression tests reject retained-resource close and assert deleted cleanup binding; tri-language release docs state the boundary
goal: 让发布验收仅在 adopter branch/worktree 已真实清理且 finalization disposition=deleted 后完成 close，并在成功与失败路径证明临时环境可清理。
intent: 修复发布验收 harness 在 staged adopter lifecycle 中保留 branch/worktree 后仍执行 close 的缺陷，使验收真实遵守合并后资源清理边界。
outOfScope: v0.2.36 tag and existing release truth

scenarioCoverage.expected: The staged candidate acceptance completes close only after its exact branch and checkout are removed, and records deleted finalization evidence.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: staged adopter lifecycle cleans resources before close
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the staged acceptance with a candidate artifact, assert lifecycle close succeeds with disposition deleted, and inspect the emitted receipt and cleanup manifest.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The old and new Work Item lifecycles in the staged upgrade fixture both complete close after exact branch and checkout cleanup without rewriting historical evidence.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: N-1 upgrade lifecycle cleans both resources before close
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the staged N-1 acceptance with public v0.2.31 and the v0.2.36 candidate, assert both close decisions and deleted finalization receipts, and compare historical evidence digests.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A failed acceptance retains acceptance.json and SHA256SUMS, marks failure without changing release truth, and removes only its validated temporary run root.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise invalid candidate and blocked-cleanup fixtures; assert failure receipts, cleanup metadata, and no unrelated path deletion.
